name: D04_3_double_strike_deals_damage_twice_at_25_life
notes: Printed: 'As long as you have 25 or more life, this creature has double strike.' Seat 0's life is 25. The 3/3 Paladin attacks and is unblocked: double strike deals first-strike damage and regular damage, 3 + 3 = 6 (20 -> 14). No life was gained, so no counter.
